sentence: Assembly of B3, B4, B5 and a 608 bearing: fits, clearances and interference certified
design_notes: The B3, B4 and B5 edits verbatim in one design, a 608 bearing as a plain 8 x 22 x 7 ring (no balls: no bearing catalog part), materials on all four, and one assembly form mated by coincident points.
